purpose: Measure a single clean real-public candidate cohort without mixing follow-up or projection denominators.

cohort_gate.required_denominator_kind: REAL_PUBLIC_CANDIDATES when candidate_count > 0; NO_CANDIDATES when candidate_count = 0

fixed_denominator.rule: Every cohort rate uses the same candidate_count denominator; task counts must never be divided by project counts.

discovery_rate.additional_gate: discovered_candidate_count must equal clean cohort candidate_count and discovery_observation_complete must be true
discovery_rate.candidate_limit_rule: When source discovery accepted more candidates than the fixed cohort cap, also report prelimit_accepted_candidate_count, prelimit_candidate_discovery_rate and candidate_limit_truncated_count.

stage4_ready_rate.numerator: unique project_rows with at least one MATCHED Stage4 task

reviewable_rate.numerator: unique project_rows allowed into Stage7 or marked limited sellable REVIEW_CANDIDATE

evidence_bundle_rate.numerator: unique cohort projects with a generated, traceable SKU-B bundle or formal leadpack package

human_review_minutes.source: non-overlapping HUMAN_REVIEW work logs with project_id, pseudonymous operator_id, started_at and ended_at
human_review_minutes.zero_rule: Zero is observable only when human_review_observation_window_complete is explicitly true

final_adoption.source: formal opportunity_outcome_event records confirmed as real customer observations
final_adoption.zero_rule: Zero is observable only when outcome_observation_window_complete is explicitly true

refund.source: formal payment_record refund states confirmed as real customer observations
refund.zero_rule: Zero is observable only when payment_observation_window_complete is explicitly true

required_observation_window.rule: Any metric marked observation-window complete must be bounded by one timezone-aware cohort window.
